ukpassthrough.settings.title: ULTRAKILL x Minecraft Settings
ukpassthrough.settings.open_ultrakill.to: Opens ULTRAKILL's own settings over the game, with your mouse (only while you're V1). Minecraft pauses meanwhile. Esc closes them and you play again.
ukpassthrough.settings.controls.tooltip: What every key does while you're V1: moving, weapons, punches, the inventory and V1's hand, menus and commands.
ukpassthrough.settings.balance.tooltip: Fine-tune the game: how fast experience turns into P and what guns cost, how big each weapon's explosions are on blocks and the toughest blocks each breaks, slams and mining, parries, knockback and how mobs and enemies fight.
ukpassthrough.settings.safe_building.too: Blocks you place (in any game mode) can't be broken by ULTRAKILL's explosions (its enemies' too), slams, shattering glass or the fire burning gasoline starts. Paintings, item frames and armor stands are kept from explosions too. Punches and the Jackhammer still mine them, TNT still goes off, and Minecraft's own creepers, TNT and fire are as ever. Blocks placed before this update aren't known.
ukpassthrough.settings.potato.tooltip: Lighter graphics in both games, keeping the look: shorter view distance (10), fast clouds, fewer particles, no shadows, less gore in ULTRAKILL. Turned off, your own settings come back.
ukpassthrough.settings.super_potato.tool: The biggest speed-up, looks rougher: view distance 6, no clouds, minimal particles, no smooth lighting, ULTRAKILL's picture at half size, simple explosions and fire, less gore and blood. Turned off, your own settings come back.
ukpassthrough.settings.blood_stains.tool: Blood stains on blocks. Off also clears the ones there are.
ukpassthrough.settings.all_weapons.toolt: Every ULTRAKILL weapon and arm, even ones you haven't unlocked, and every gun colour option. Only in this mod: your ULTRAKILL save isn't changed.
ukpassthrough.settings.remove_weapons.to: No guns and no Sandbox arm: V1 fights with its fists, the Whiplash and whatever Minecraft weapon it holds. Only in this mod: your ULTRAKILL save isn't changed.
ukpassthrough.settings.progression.toolt: Start from nothing: all of ULTRAKILL's guns and the Sandbox arm are taken away and your P starts at 0 (only in this mod, and kept for each world). Experience you pick up turns into P instead (a zombie's experience is 1,000 P); buy weapons with it in Change Loadout.... Owning all three variants of a weapon unlocks its alternate. Your arms stay.
ukpassthrough.settings.loadout.tooltip: ULTRAKILL's own shop terminal opens as a menu over the game: click its buttons with your mouse (weapons, variants, alternates, order, arms, gun colours), as at a terminal in ULTRAKILL. Esc closes it. What you equip and the colours you pick there only count in this mod (your ULTRAKILL loadout and colours aren't changed), and nothing can be bought here. Only while you're V1.
ukpassthrough.settings.loadout.removed: Turn off Remove All Weapons to change the loadout.
ukpassthrough.settings.loadout_mine.tool: Back to your loadout and gun colours as ULTRAKILL itself has them (this mod's own are forgotten).
ukpassthrough.settings.cheats.tooltip: ULTRAKILL's cheats (its cheats menu, cheat keys and the Sandbox arm) in survival and adventure too. Off: only in creative; leaving creative puts any cheats that were on away until you're back in creative.
ukpassthrough.settings.sensitivity.toolt: ULTRAKILL's mouse sensitivity, which is what turns V1 (its own setting).
ukpassthrough.settings.fov.tooltip: ULTRAKILL's field of view, which is also Minecraft's while you're V1 (its own setting).
ukpassthrough.settings.not_connected.too: Start ULTRAKILL to change its settings here.
ukpassthrough.settings.explosions.toolti: How much of Minecraft's blocks ULTRAKILL's explosions break. 100% breaks about what each explosion covers; Off breaks nothing.
ukpassthrough.settings.slam.tooltip: A ground slam cracks dirt and other soft blocks (a second slam or one from 20 blocks up breaks them) and breaks glass and ice.
ukpassthrough.settings.glass.tooltip: Shots, cannonballs, the drill and punches break glass and ice at once, and beams go through every pane. Off: glass is like any other block.
ukpassthrough.settings.enemy_size.toolti: How big ULTRAKILL's enemies are, compared with ULTRAKILL. At 80% a Filth is about a zombie's height.
ukpassthrough.settings.fights.tooltip: ULTRAKILL's enemies and Minecraft's mobs fight each other. Off: ULTRAKILL's enemies only go for V1, and mobs ignore them.
ukpassthrough.settings.v1_damage.tooltip: How hard V1's weapons hit Minecraft's mobs. At 100% a revolver headshot kills a zombie.
ukpassthrough.settings.damage_taken.tool: How hard Minecraft hurts V1 (mobs, explosions, fire, lava).
ukpassthrough.settings.back.tooltip: How far behind V1 the over-the-shoulder camera sits (F5), in blocks.
ukpassthrough.settings.right.tooltip: Which shoulder the over-the-shoulder camera sits over, and how far to that side, in blocks.
ukpassthrough.settings.up.tooltip: How far above V1's eyes the over-the-shoulder camera sits, in blocks.
ukpassthrough.settings.front.tooltip: How far in front of V1 the camera sits when it looks back at V1 (F5 twice), in blocks.
ukpassthrough.settings.status_line.toolt: The green 'ULTRAKILL: connected' line in the top left corner.
ukpassthrough.settings.light.tooltip: Minecraft's light (night, caves, torches) on V1's arms and body and on ULTRAKILL's enemies. Off: they're always fully lit.
ukpassthrough.settings.balance.title: ULTRAKILL x Minecraft Balance
In Progression Mode, how much P each point of Minecraft experience you pick up gives (200 at the start: a zombie's experience is 1,000 P).
ukpassthrough.settings.balance.gun_price: In Progression Mode, what weapons cost at Change Loadout..., compared with the usual prices (the Piercer 2,500 P, the variants up to 100,000 P).
ukpassthrough.settings.balance.size.rock: How big the explosions of rockets are on Minecraft's blocks (100% at the start), on top of Explosions on Blocks. Off: they break no blocks.
ukpassthrough.settings.balance.breaks.ro: The toughest blocks the explosions of rockets break. Like TNT: as Minecraft's TNT (dirt easily, stone a little, obsidian never). The others go by the pickaxe a block needs, and every block up to it breaks as easily as dirt: Soft Blocks (dirt, sand, wood, leaves, glass, wool), Stone (stone, cobblestone, coal ore), Iron Ore (iron, copper and lapis), Diamond Ore (diamond, gold, emerald and redstone), Obsidian (obsidian, ancient debris, netherite). Bedrock never breaks.

ukpassthrough.settings.balance.slam_size: How wide a ground slam's patch of cracked and broken blocks is (100%: about 4 blocks across).
ukpassthrough.settings.balance.punch_dig: How much each Knuckleblaster punch digs at a block, compared with a second of mining by hand (100% at the start: dirt in one punch, wood in three).
ukpassthrough.settings.balance.jackhamme: Which pickaxe the Jackhammer mines as (Iron at the start): one strike breaks any block that pickaxe can mine, with that pickaxe's drops. Off: it doesn't mine.
ukpassthrough.settings.balance.parry_dam: How much a parry hurts the mob whose attack you parried.
ukpassthrough.settings.balance.knockback: How far V1's weapons, punches and slams knock Minecraft's mobs back.
ukpassthrough.settings.balance.windup.to: How long a mob's attack on V1 winds up before it lands: your time to parry it (0.30 s at the start).
ukpassthrough.settings.balance.mob_reach: How far a mob's attack reaches V1, compared with how far it reaches a normal player (50% at the start).
ukpassthrough.settings.balance.enemy_dam: How hard ULTRAKILL's enemies hit Minecraft's mobs.
ukpassthrough.settings.balance.mobs_on_e: How hard Minecraft's mobs hit ULTRAKILL's enemies.
ukpassthrough.settings.balance.reset.too: Every setting on this page back to the mod's usual values.
ukpassthrough.settings.balance.reset.det: Everything on this page goes back to the mod's usual values. The rest of the settings stay as they are.
ukpassthrough.settings.reset.tooltip: Every setting here back to how it was when you started the game.
ukpassthrough.settings.reset.question: Reset every setting here?
ukpassthrough.settings.reset.detail: Everything in this menu goes back to how it was when you started the game, ULTRAKILL's settings too.
